text:
mike: Quick heads-up: hit a weird streaming edge where SSE chunks arrive out-of-order after a client reconnect. Repro is simple: open stream -> kill client -> reconnect -> assembled text has swapped fragments and sometimes no final `event: done` shows.
anya: Which SDK/version and client libs? Mobile or desktop?
mike: inference-js v1.3.0 and a lightweight Android HTTP client. Raw capture (trimmed):
```
data: {"seq":101,"t":"open"}

data: {"seq":102,"t":"pa"}

<disconnect>
/data: {"seq":102,"t":"rt"}
data: {"seq":103,"t":"close"}
/event: done
```
Notice the `/data:` and split `pa`/`rt` pieces and duplicated seq=102. Looks like partial write + reconnect concat.
raul: Sounds like two problems: (1) naive parser splitting strictly on `\n\n` which fails on mid-JSON splits, (2) reconnect logic replays some bytes leading to duplicates. We should make SDK parser tolerant and server should emit SSE `id:` for resume.
anya: Agreed. Parity notes: py SDK keeps partial line in buffer; JS uses stream reader and sometimes emits chunk-level callbacks before full event is assembled.
dev-bot: stream-metrics(us-west-2): rising reconnects and 0.02% missing-done events in last hour.
ci-bot: CI sse-repro: flaky on packet-split case. See run 4523.
mike: Proposed SDK behavior: buffer until a blank-line event boundary OR detect `data:` prefix at line start; strip leading garbage (non-alpha) before token; maintain small seq cache to drop duplicates; on reconnect honor Last-Event-ID header to request resume.
raul: Server-side: ensure atomic event writes where possible, emit `id: <seq>` on each event, and send `:ping` every 20s. Ticket INF-1204.
anya: Also add a reconnect hold window in SDK (200-300ms) to wait for near-term arrivals before reordering; makes sense for mobile flaps.
mike: Edge case: auth retries cause the client to re-open with a fresh session and server may re-emit a few events. We need X-Stream-Session header so server can dedupe replays. SDK ticket SDK-834.
raul: I'll add lightweight integration test that emulates mid-packet split and TCP close; assert assembled text == golden. Also add a monitor to count missing `event: done` occurrences.
mike: I'll patch the JS SDK parser and add a feature flag `sse_strict_reorder=false` for one release for backwards compat.
anya: Nice. Let's coordinate infra + SDK rollouts. Meeting to sync tomorrow 10:30.
mike: Thanks all :thumbsup:
